name: publicrecords--sports-odds-api
description:
Sports Odds API: BetRivers, Unibet, Paf, Svenska Spel, ATG. Live odds from 24 Kambi-powered sportsbooks in one call: BetRivers (12 US states + Ontario), Unibet (7 countries), Paf, Svenska Spel and ATG. One row per game with every book's price and the best price per outcome.

When to use: Use when you need current pre-match or live prices for a game or league from Kambi-powered books (BetRivers, Unibet, Paf, Svenska Spel, ATG) and want to compare books or find the best price per outcome. Not for DraftKings/FanDuel or historical odds.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/sports-odds-api" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/sports-odds-api

arguments.name: leagues
arguments.desc: Kambi paths, sport or league level: "basketball/nba", "american_football/nfl", "ice_hockey/nhl", "baseball/mlb", "football/england/premier_league", or a whole sport such as "tennis". Unknown paths are answered with suggestions and are never charged.

arguments.name: operators
arguments.desc: Kambi-powered books to price. Each book is a separate brand/jurisdiction feed; prices can differ between them. The list contains only books verified open on the date in the README.

arguments.name: markets
arguments.desc: "main" returns the headline markets per game. "all" returns each game's full board (often 300–500 markets) and is priced higher. Options: main = Main lines (moneyline, spread, total); all = Every market incl. player props and alternates.

arguments.name: includeLive
arguments.desc: Include games already started (live prices at the moment of the run).

arguments.name: startsWithinHours
arguments.desc: 0 = no limit. Live games are kept when "Include in-play games" is on.

arguments.name: proxyConfiguration
arguments.desc: On by default. Kambi limits how often one IP may ask; your run moves to a fresh Apify Proxy IP whenever it is slowed down. Turn off only to test without a proxy.
